# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Class B

> 13-hour online entry-level driver training (theory) for a Class B commercial driver's license, in accordance with FMCSA and DOT regulations in 49 CFR Part 380. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Regulation: 49 CFR Part 380 (FMCSA ELDT rule, in effect since February 2022)
- Class B: single vehicles with GVWR of 26,001 lb or more, including when towing a trailer of 10,000 lb GVWR or less (e.g., straight, delivery and dump trucks; many school, transit and shuttle buses)
- Passenger and school bus driving usually also requires a P or S endorsement
- Duration: 13 hours; 5 modules, 29 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 1.3 CEU
- Price: $159.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: completion reported to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry
- Not included: behind-the-wheel training
- State acceptance: every state except Washington
- Typical prerequisites: age 18+ (21+ for interstate), valid non-commercial license, DOT physical

## Modules
1. Basic Operation of a Commercial Motor Vehicle (6 lessons)
2. Safe Operating Procedures (7 lessons)
3. Advanced Operating Practices (3 lessons)
4. Vehicle Systems and Reporting Malfunctions (3 lessons)
5. Non-Driving Activities (10 lessons)
